records.prompt: Create ONE new opaque full-bleed horizontal 1000x760 card illustration: a heroic poster of SOVEREIGN BLADE. COMPOSITION (percent of canvas): MAKOTO'S SWORD stands upright, blade pointing down, planted in the ground at the bottom center, tilted about 6 degrees clockwise: pommel at about (51%, 14%), crossguard at about (50%, 30%), blade tip buried at about (48%, 80%). It is the biggest and brightest shape (about 13% of the canvas width at the crossguard). A thin cyan-gold glow runs along its cutting edge. A CROWN OF SPECTRAL BLADES: from a point just behind the grip, EIGHT slimmer translucent ice-cyan ghost copies of the same sword radiate outward like the points of a royal crown or sunburst, fanning across the upper half in an arc of about 140 degrees; the longest two reach about x10% and x90%, the shortest point almost straight up; semi-transparent with bright white edges; all stay inside the safe area. GROUND: a dark plain with two rows of tall narrow black COFFINS (silver trim, pale cyan edge light) standing upright in receding perspective on both sides of the sword, large ones at the lower corners partly cropped, smaller ones fading toward the horizon; a few iron chains lie across the ground; a thin low mist. SKY: deep teal-navy with a few large flat diagonal bands behind the crown and a few four-point star glints; no moon. PALETTE: deep navy and teal about 60%, silver and ice-white, cyan; a single warm gold accent only on the blade-edge glow. AVOID: no people, hands or faces, no Regent star emblem, no gold ornate hilt. Same visual language as the existing card set: bold hard-edged cel-shading, thick dark outlines with a thin bright rim light on the hero shapes, large flat colour planes with a few deep near-black occlusion planes, crisp clean details, a strong poster composition that reads at 250x190 thumbnail size. It is Slay the Spire 2 card art re-skinned for Persona 3 Reload. No blur, no soft bloom, no photoreal rendering, no gradients except subtle sky gradients. Keep every important feature inside x8-92%, y10-76% (the card frame crops the rest). Opaque, full-bleed, no text, letters, numerals, UI, frame, border or watermark. Makoto Yuki's face and head never appear. Generate this as a NEW illustration; there is no original to preserve.

records.prompt: Create ONE new opaque full-bleed horizontal 1000x760 card illustration: VOID FORM, the hidden hour frozen in time. COMPOSITION (percent of canvas): a huge round CLOCK FACE seen almost head-on in the center (center at (50%, 47%), diameter about 62% of the canvas width): dark gunmetal rim with thin silver edging, a deep black face, twelve small four-point-star markers in place of numerals (NO numerals), and both slim silver filigree clock hands pointing straight up at twelve, overlapping. AROUND THE CLOCK a FROZEN EXPLOSION: a ring of hard-edged translucent pale-blue GLASS SHARDS, like a shattered Persona summon, hanging motionless in mid-air, expanding outward from the clock's center, large shards near the edges and tiny ones near the center, with crisp white highlights. Among the shards hang FIVE TAROT CARDS (royal-blue backs with a gold four-point star, no text) at different tilts, each with a tiny cyan glint, positioned roughly at (19%, 27%), (79%, 24%), (15%, 55%), (84%, 53%) and (50%, 15%). At the clock's center floats a small silver EVOKER (a gun-shaped summoner: short barrel ringed with small slots) horizontally, muzzle pointing right, with a tiny hot-pink glint at the muzzle, frozen mid-flash. BACKGROUND: dark teal-green with a few large flat diagonal bands, and a few giant black COFFIN silhouettes as flat dark shapes in the far distance. EVERYTHING IS STILL: no motion blur, no speed lines. PALETTE: Dark Hour teal-green about 40%, black about 25%, ice-white and pale blue glass about 25%, royal-blue cards, one small hot-pink accent. AVOID: no people, no faces, no butterflies or wings, no text or numerals.
